in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivanshuva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shivanshuva is a unisex Hindu name that means 'The Protector of Lord Shiva'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shiva' (the Hindu god of destruction) and 'Anshu' (protector).
